title: cdk-construct-slackbot examples (all languages)
description:
Create runnable examples in packages/cdk-construct-slackbot/examples/.

Scenarios:
- minimal/ — slackChannels map + slackTokenSecretArn from bridge fixture secrets.slack_token_arn
- with-kms/ — slackTokenSecretKmsKeyArn from bridge fixture (divergent: KMS decrypt permission added)
- comprehensive/ — all optional props: custom lambda code path, runtime, log expiration, pub/sub principals

All 5 languages. Assertion tests in test/slackbot-examples.test.ts.

comments.author: lead-engineer
comments.body: PR merged: slackbot examples on develop
